sourceTitle: PG Edition of Netherlands series — Complete
description: "The PG Edition of Netherlands Series — Complete" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. This work provides a comprehensive exploration of the significant historical events surrounding the rise of the Dutch Republic from 1555 to 1623, delving into the political, military, and social dynamics that contributed to its emergence.
